sourceBaseline.source: Greenfield v1.8.3 release package (this delivery chain)

change.purpose: Operator report 2026-09-25 (chrome://extensions errors, sidepanel.html): 'Pattern attribute value GPT[- ][0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,3}( [A-Za-z0-9_-]+){0,3} is not a valid regular expression ... /v: Invalid character in character class'.
change.rootCause: Chrome compiles an HTML pattern attribute with the unicodeSets (v) flag; an unescaped '-' inside a character class ([- ], [A-Za-z0-9_-]) is a syntax error there. The invalid pattern was ignored (no constraint) and logged when the field was validated. Present since the v1.7.6 baseline; unrelated to the extension being closed.
change.impact: requiredModel field accepted any text client-side (Chromium: 'foo' valid); background normalizePolicy still rejected invalid values with SAFETY_MODEL_POLICY_INVALID, so no invalid policy could be stored
change.fix: sidepanel.html requiredModel pattern [Gg][Pp][Tt][\- ][0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,3}(\s+[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+){0,3}: valid in v mode and syntactically equivalent to lib/safety-policy.js (case-insensitive GPT, \s+ separators), so every stored policy remains valid in the now-enforced field

carriedFrom1_8_3.conditions: BRIDGE_UNRESPONSIVE, BRIDGE_MISSING, TAB_DISCARDED, RENDER_STALLED (visible >=45 s and requested frame not delivered >=45 s), COMPOSER_MISSING (SENDING), THREAD_MISSING (conversation URL with 0 turns); Chrome-frozen tabs are waited out; managed tabs set autoDiscardable:false
carriedFrom1_8_3.ladder: REINJECT (bridge missing only) -> RELOAD -> HARD_RELOAD -> NAVIGATE_SAME_URL -> REPLACE_TAB (same conversation, same window, old tab closed, existing single-tab rebind) -> GIVE_UP (session rotation TAB_HEALTH_RECOVERY_EXHAUSTED); UI grace 90 s, 45 s between steps, budget 5 actions/hour/process, no UI step while a dispatch has unknown effect
carriedFrom1_8_3.tickRescue: watchdog does not enqueue behind a tick in flight > 3 min; reloads the tab at most every 5 min in WAITING/SENDING(no dispatch)/DETACHED/RECOVERING/ROTATING; audit TICK_STALL_RESCUE
carriedFrom1_8_3.providerNotice: content.js detectProviderNotice: 'Daybreak' + headline (en/sv) or cyber word (en/sv/fi), outside every message turn, after the anchor user turn; acted on after two sightings >= 3 s apart and not while generating; the turn is not counted in the quantum; learning keypoints POST_FAILURE / RECURRING PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCK_REPEATED
carriedFrom1_8_3.pause: queue slot: schedule.pauseUntilMs = max(existing, now + pause), updatedBy GREENFIELD, status READY, parked PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCKED_PAUSED, queue continues (QUEUE_WAIT when none runnable); outside a queue: hold PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCK_PAUSE
